answer_1.quote: IMO-Bench covers three different tasks... IMO-AnswerBench, IMO-ProofBench, IMO-GradingBench
answer_1.outputs: The models generate short answers and full mathematical proofs for Olympiad-level problems, and also assess the correctness of given proofs.

answer_2.quote: AnswerAutoGrader's performance is nearly identical to that of human evaluators, validating its use for future public usage and also for reporting the results in this work.

answer_3.quote: We incorporate an approach of prompting a large language model as an automated verifier for the model answers on IMO-AnswerBench. We name this language model component as AnswerAutoGrader.
methods: prompting LLM to extract and verify final answer
prompting LLM to grade proofs with reference solution and guidelines

answer_4.quote: Model outputs on IMO-ProofBench were graded by human experts according to the guidelines described in Section B.2.
answer_4.guideline: We provide a primary grading guideline with four ratings (Correct, Almost, Partial, Incorrect)... human experts are empowered to use their own judgments to assign any integer score from 0 to 7 for each problem.
